committee.sub: Morning brief · Saturday 28 November 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Lifetime spend is $1,977.43 ex GST across 39 lifetime clicks, and since the landing page test began it has logged 108 raw paid clicks for $754.48, with the $600 promo credit now fully drawn (creditRemainingExGst $0). campaignStatus shows PAUSED, which matches the pre-agreed rule given review_cta_click still sits at 0, no qualified prospect has booked.

Of the 108 raw clicks on /free-workflow-review.html, ask_cta_click fired 11 times and quick_question_click 5 times, but review_cta_click is still 0: the short question form is drawing interest while the deeper booking step gets none. The page has been frozen since click 25 under the test rule, so no further copy changes unless something breaks.

generate_lead has fired 3 times since the test started (eventsSinceStart.generate_lead=3), yet leads.last7 is 0, so none of those three landed in the past week. Each needs grading against the qualified rule (real business, repeatable admin process, named system) by checking its Formspree/Cal.com source email before it counts as a genuine enquiry.

Organic Search held flat at 7 sessions (prior 7, google/organic now 7 vs 6), still the only unpaid signal worth trusting given Direct's 7 sessions likely include Chris and untracked referrers. Search Console data (through 2026-11-25, already two days behind yesterday) shows 257 impressions but only 5 clicks over 8 days, and the top page /simpro-xero-integration.html drew 76 impressions for 0 clicks at position 14: visibility without traction. AI Assistant sessions are flat at 0 this week.

actions.text: The $600 test credit has hit $0 remaining, so the decision point is due: paid search stays paused unless cost per qualified enquiry is $480 or less and at least one qualified prospect has booked a review. No qualified booking exists yet, so the current pause stands.
totalPaidClicks has reached 108, well past the 75-click checkpoint. Chris needs to check the test log: if relevant clicks are 75 or more with zero qualified enquiries, the red flag fires.
Three generate_lead events have fired since the test started. Check each Formspree/Cal.com email for its source and grade it in the test log against the qualified rule.
Standing item: logo and image assets for the serving ad groups (Agency, Job Intake) are still outstanding.
Standing item: RSA descriptions on the non-Agency ads still claim 13.3 hours of admin per week and 99.6% success and need updating to current site stats.
